must.title: Security of Scaffold Generation Process
must.description: Ensure the scaffold generation process is secure and free from vulnerabilities.
must.metric: No security vulnerabilities in the scaffold generation process.
acceptance_criteria: Security tests show no vulnerabilities in scaffold generation.
Code review confirms adherence to security best practices.
Penetration tests reveal no exploitable weaknesses.
must.verification: Conduct SAST and pre-prod pen test on scaffold generation code.

should.title: Performance of Scaffold Generation
should.description: Ensure scaffold generation completes within acceptable time limits.
should.metric: Scaffold generation completes within 5 seconds per macro.
acceptance_criteria: Scaffold generation for each macro completes within 5 seconds.
Performance tests confirm generation time under load conditions.
No significant delays observed during scaffold generation.
should.verification: Load test scaffold generation at 10× expected load; measure completion time.

should.title: Scalability of Scaffold Generation
should.description: Ensure the scaffold generation process can scale to handle increased load.
should.metric: Scaffold generation scales to handle 100 concurrent requests.
acceptance_criteria: Scaffold generation supports 100 concurrent requests without degradation.
Scalability tests confirm performance under increased load.
No errors occur during concurrent scaffold generation.
should.verification: Load test with 100 concurrent requests; measure performance metrics.

should.title: Usability of Scaffold Verification
should.description: Ensure the verification process for scaffolds is user-friendly and efficient.
should.metric: Verification process completes within 2 minutes and is intuitive.
acceptance_criteria: Verification process is completed within 2 minutes.
User feedback confirms the process is intuitive and efficient.
No significant user errors reported during verification.
should.verification: Conduct user testing and gather feedback on verification process usability.
